name: Dual CFG Guider, nested style
plain: Same three conditionings, but CFG is applied inside CFG: the first positive is guided against the second, and the result is then guided against the negative. It always runs all three.
math:
x̂_text = cfg_function(cond=x̂_p, uncond=x̂_m, s₁)
x̂ = x̂_n + s₂·(x̂_text − x̂_n)
Here post-CFG hooks run on the inner step only, not on the final line.
label: from code
surprise: The cfg1 skip is not available in nested style: all three conds are always evaluated.
